task: Cut long silent gaps from a video
packaging_note: Uses the release executable for your CPU and exports a local MP4.

inputs.what: a video with an audio track

outputs.what: an MP4 with silent stretches cut out

known_issues: Quiet speech can be treated as silence; keep the original. Inputs with no audible sections cannot produce an edit.
licence: Unlicense (auto-editor); release also contains third-party media libraries.

settings.name: MARGIN_SECONDS
settings.what: seconds to leave on each side of audible passages; default 0.1
settings.how: Use 0 for tight cuts or 0.5 to keep breathing room.

settings.name: AUDIO_THRESHOLD
settings.what: audio level that counts as audible, from 0 to 1; default 0.04
settings.how: Lower this to retain quieter speech. Raise it to cut more background noise.

x-display.title: Cut silent gaps from a video
x-display.summary: Remove quiet stretches from a video and save a shorter MP4.
x-display.description: Make a first editing pass through a spoken recording, such as a tutorial or presentation. The cuts follow the audio level, leaving you a shorter video to review and refine in your usual editor.
